card.name: Missed or vomited dose instructions
card.fires_on: The verb or word right after a missed or vomited dose is mentioned, such as continue, resume, next, take, repeat, or then. It appears in instructions on what to do next.

modes.label: The resume-the-schedule wording
modes.description: Verbs or words that tell the patient to go back to the regular schedule after a missed dose.
modes.example: take the dose as soon as possible on the same day and<< resume>> their next dose at the normal schedule the

modes.label: The take-the-next-dose wording
modes.description: The word next in 'take the next dose' after a missed or vomited dose.
modes.example: and take the<< next>> dose at the next regularly scheduled time.

modes.label: The repeat-after-vomiting wording
modes.description: The word dose or repeat after vomiting following a dose.
modes.example: In the event of vomiting within 1 hour after dosing, a repeat<< dose>> should be given.

card.plain: It responds to the words that say what comes after a missed or vomited dose, like resume or take the next dose.
